::: {.qube-card}
### Hands-On Learning & Interdisciplinary Collaboration
The **QUBE Discovery Lab** prepares young people to apply mathematical, computational, and statistical reasoning to real-world biological and health problems.
:::

## What Participants Do

- **Data-Driven Inquiry:** Explore datasets from life sciences, clinical medicine, environmental health, and public health.
- **Computational & Statistical Skills:** Build practical experience in data visualization, statistical modeling, and scientific reasoning.
- **Mentored Research Projects:** Collaborate in teams with guidance from QUBE's [Graduate Student Advisors and Expert Advisors](../leadership/advisors.qmd) to prepare projects for the [QUBE Youth Research Showcase Symposium](research-showcase-symposium.qmd).
